name: README.md
html:
luiskr.com V3 — experiments/earth-playground

The Earth Playground — <view-space-playground> — a photorealistic Three.js WebGPU Earth rendered fullscreen behind a live control panel. Reachable at /earth-playground (localized), it's the site's flagship visual experiment: a real-time planet with physically-motivated atmosphere scattering, day/night terminator, city lights, a 3-level-LOD moon, eclipse dimming, and a full post-processing chain — every parameter tweakable live through sliders, checkboxes, and actions.

How it works

SpacePlayground.tsx mounts a persistent canvas and hands it to EarthBackground (earth-background.ts), the engine facade. The engine lazily imports Three.js (the chunk only ships when the route mounts), probes for a WebGPU adapter — falling back to WebGL on a cloned canvas — builds the scene, loads the texture set, assembles the TSL post pipeline, then starts the frame loop. Controls are a method API (update* setters) — no lil-gui — fed by a declarative panel schema.

Source map

The view + engine facade

FileWhat it does
SpacePlayground.tsx<view-space-playground> — the route: canvas + control panel (sliders, checkboxes, actions, position readout, music). Settings persist to localStorage; loader stays until first usable frame.
earth-background.tsEarthBackground facade — owns the EarthState bag, exposes init() + the update* API the panel drives.
dev.tsStandalone dev entry — mounts the view directly.
index.tsBarrel.
vite.config.jsLibrary build — emits earth-playground/dist/earth-playground.js.

earth/setup/ — boot

FileWhat it does
setup/bootstrap.tsAsync scene assembly — lazy three import, WebGPU probe, renderer/scene/camera/controls, texture loading with progress, post pipeline, warmup. Every await checks s.disposed.
setup/renderer-setup.tsRenderer creation — navigator.gpu adapter probe (a null adapter means software/headless), WebGPURenderer covering both APIs, poisoned-canvas clone + WebGL retry.
setup/scene-setup.tsScene rig — camera + OrbitControls, sun directional + sprite, equirect starfield background, moon LOD.
setup/post-setup.tsPost chain — color grade, chromatic aberration, vignette, film grain + RenderPipeline assembly; failure is non-fatal (frame loop falls back).

earth/scene/ — the planet

FileWhat it does
scene/meshes.tsMesh builders — the 4-shell Earth group and the 3-LOD moon; orchestrates textures, geometry, groups.
scene/surface-material.tsSurface node graph — cloud-shadow projection, day/night + twilight tint, ocean specular, normal-map terrain shading, moon-eclipse dimming, night-lights emissive.
scene/atmos-shells.tsAtmosphere shells — BackSide additive scattering (Rayleigh + Mie + airglow limb bands from inside) + FrontSide fresnel rim.
scene/post-nodes.tsCustom TSL post nodes — pure node-graph builders.
earth/consts.tsScene-graph scale constants + shared TSL arg types.

earth/runtime/ — per-frame behavior

FileWhat it does
runtime/state.tscreateEarthState — the mutable engine-state bag threaded through every stage.
runtime/frame.tsThe self-rescheduling RAF tick — sun orbit, moon orbit, earth/cloud spin, controls damping, pipeline-or-plain render; host-aware resize.
runtime/updates.tsLive-tweak API — every update* writes the settings bag + backing uniform; toggles collapse shader terms to 0 (no graph rebuild).
runtime/screenshot.tsPNG capture — 2× pixel-ratio frame → toDataURL/toBlob download.
earth/settings.tsSettings snapshot → DEFAULT_SP_GUI-shaped tree the panel renders.

space/ — the control surface

FileWhat it does
space/boot.tsEngine bootstrap — canvas → engine with ready/progress callbacks mirrored into the loader; persisted settings applied.
space/controls.tsThe declarative SLIDER_GROUPS schema + SP_PARAMS → update* adapter map + versioned localStorage.
space/i18n.tsLocale handling — fetches the earth-playground node, merges CMS-published defaults over shipped config.
space/wiring.tsPanel event binding — data-param dispatch, action buttons, readout loop, CheckboxWebGL mounts.
space/checkbox-webgl.tsThe panel's checkbox widget — Canvas 2D accent ticks + scan-glow pulse.
space/panel-render.tsxRow/group JSX renderers.
space/render.tsxView JSX — loader overlay, collapsible panel, music player.

Commands

yarn dev      # mounts <view-space-playground> directly
yarn test     # jest suite for earth-playground
yarn build    # emits experiments/earth-playground/dist/earth-playground.js

Submodule of luiskr.com-V3. Install deps from the superproject (yarn install at the root), then run yarn dev / yarn test / yarn build in this folder — see package.json scripts.
